claims.quote: Eighty per cent of patients with Dravet syndrome have a mutation in SCN1A, encoding Nav1.1.
Milder clinical phenotypes, such as GEFS+ (generalized epilepsy with febrile seizures plus), can also arise from SCN1A mutations.
